entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tikotamise tose misoro yedu. Hanzi, “Pane vaviri kana vatatu muZita Rangu, Ini ndiripowo. ” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Anogugudza anozarurirwa, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anotsvaka anowana, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] anokumbira anopuhwa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Regai munhu wese ave murevi wenhema, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] Mwari vave murevi weZvokwadi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Taishuva sei kuti dai Mwari vaisangana nesu. Mumwe nemumwe nezvishuwo zvake, netarisiro yake, Mwari va—mupe zvikumbiro zvemwoyo wake. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba tinotenda panguva ino Jehovha wakarurama yemanheru. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kutenda kwedu kuri mukuziva, kuti basa rose makatipedzera. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinomira pano tichiziva kuti Imi Ndimi munotigonera. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makatibhisa, Baba mumweya wemadzinza. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makatibhisa mumweya wohurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makatibhisa Baba wakarurama, mukurova makuva nemukupira mudzimu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Makatidzidzisa kuti, “Kukuzivai Imimi, ndihwo hupenyu.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kusvika panhasi hamusati matinyadzisa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Chiuyai Baba wakanaka kune vanenge vakasaririra mukati meKereke yaMwari, kuti vabate chizaruro ichi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Umwe nemumwe ari mukati memba ino Baba wakarurama abude muno achiti, “Zvanga zvakanaka, kuti ndive muimba yaMwari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Arege kubuda muno ari pakati, ari double minded, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] abuda muno atogamuchira. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ishe tinoisa mumwe nemumwe auya muno angava munhu asati akutambirai, [Congregation says, “mm,”] angava akakutambirai kare wa’akuneta. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makanaka makatipa simba mukatotiti, “Hakuna weapon ichagadzirwa nevanhu, [Congregation says, ‘Amen,’] ichaita kuda kwayo Nemi imi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Baba tinokunda uroyi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokunda Ishe, principalities and forces. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka tiri muno Baba wakanaka tiri kutsuura hurombo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiri kutsuura hurwere. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba tinokumbira makomborero Enyu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kuti apinde pakati pedu Jehovha. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndotichishuva kuti gore rino status yedu, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] kubudikidza nekutenda muna Jeso, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] isandurwe Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tiwane mabasa akanaka, tikudze vana vedu, Baba tiendese vana kuzvikoro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tichengete madzimai edu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tivake makereke, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] tiparidze iVhangeri. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Satani tama muimba yaMwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Pataisa tsoka dzedu, we “…possess the gate of the enemy.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chiuyai mupindire Baba wakanaka kuna officer mumwe nemumwe, iye nemhuri yake vave example. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vave a living temple, vave ma written epistles. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chipindai kuvatsvene vese Baba, ava ambassadors for Christ. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Every brother and every sister in the house of God, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] vave an ambassador for Christ. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Buritsai deceit muzvipfuva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Buritsai hypocrisy muzvipfuva zve… [Inaudible 0:02:36] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotsuura Satani Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Chitipai kukunamatai manheru ano Jehovha. Muve nesu Baba wakanaka papfungwa dzatinadzo dzose Svondo ino. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Zvikuru takatarisana nenzvimbo ino, kuti ive commercial. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba chishuwo chatiinacho. Takatarisana Baba nekuzarurwa kwedenga, kusvika tinoshaya pokuisa maropafadzo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mari yekuvaka maKereke Baba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitibatsirai Baba, tinotenda nezvatakaitirwa zvose. Baba goho ratinaro. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hutano hwatinahwo pakufamba kwese kwatinoita, munotichengeta Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Chengetai hama dziri Joni, hama dziri Botswana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chengetai hama dziri ku diaspora. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vari kukumbira Baba wakanaka kuti mu—muzarure mikana, pindirai Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iye zvino Baba wakanaka ta’amukati memba Yenyu kudai, tibatsirei Jehovha wakarurama kuti tibude muno tine chatabata. Tabwinya tava mukukunamatai, tichipa mbiri kuZita Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ivai nemumwe nemumwe wedu Baba wakarurama, tigoti, “Zvanga zvakanaka kuti tive muimba yaMwari.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tichengeterei mhuri dzedu nevana vedu, dzimba dzedu nepfuma yedu, tarisirai Mwari wekururama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinokutendai Jehovha wakarurama, tichitenda kuti Satan pahupenyu hwedu haana simba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Izvozvi tinomuraira kuti atame. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Come out Satan! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] In Jesus’ Name. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Baba makarurama mutitendere kuva tinoita “…possess the gates of the enemy.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Chitisimbisai neShoko Renyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “We are as strong as the Word in us.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitibatanidzai mu one accord, Baba nokuti ipapo ndopanoburuka Mweya Wenyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tinotenda manheru anhasi. Kudzwai namatwai nekusingapere, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu, Amen and Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Aiwa tinotenda Mwari.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinokwazisana tose muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mufaro wedu kuva muimba yaMwari. Hanzi, “You can never pray too…? [Congregation says, ‘too much,’] too much.” Saka kunamata hakumbofa kwakazonzi kwanyanya. Tinotenda Mwari nazvo izvozvo. Saka we should pray twenty-four se…? [Congregation says, “seven,”] seven, if the Lord gives us the grace. Tikaona zvatinoitirwa naMwari… Ndaindichitozvitaura ndikati, “Aah isusu, tichatopota tichitoti kana tazokwanisa hedu kuti zvedu zvirongeke zvakanaka, tipote tichiita even ma morning prayer me…? [Congregation says, “meetings,”] ekutenda Mwari kuseni, tozoita nemanheru.” Isu zvedu vanenge vari pano hazvitiremeri, handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Kunamata kwakanaka chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo,”] chaizvo. Rambai muchinyengetera. Mwari ndomavanokupa simba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. Tinokwazisa Baba va Brother Nyaude, ta’akuvaziva. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kubva pamuchato, ndofunga vazhinji venyu ma’akuvaziva handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Tinotenda kuva navo manheru anhasi, muZita raTenzi Jeso Kristu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka toda kuti tiende mberi nemharidzo yedu, Mwari achititendera. Tichine nyaya yedu ye The Revelation. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handimuchaiziva nyaya yatakabata pa weekend? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ye The Revelation. Chizaruro, chatiri kutarisira kuti munhu mumwe nemumwe anga aina…? [Congregation says, “ainacho,”] ainacho handiti? Saka nhasi ndoda kuti ndimboemphasaiza pamweya uyu; kupinda kwawakaita mumache… mumachechi. Ta’akubata manje kuti mweya uyu watiri kudhira [to deal—ED] nawo i Revelation 17, i Revelation 18. Inonzi, “Mystery Ba…?” [Congregation says, “Babylon,”] Babylon.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: But origin yawo, tinonounhonga kuna Genesis chapter te…? [Congregation says, “ten,”] ten. Ende ta’akuziva kuti nhasi mweya uyu, it’s in the form of a church today, handiti? [Congregation says “mm-hm.”] Ende kereke iyi ine, zvakawanda zvayafurira. Handi’ta’akuzviziva? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vanhu va’akutoita manamatiro iwa…? [Congregation says, “iwayo,”] iwayo. Vachiona sekuti kunamata. Nevanenge vakabva kwairi chechi iyi, havazvizive kuti havana kubva. Nekuti vaiti vakabuda imomo, vaiita carry over mweya yacho, vonotanga Baptist. But mweya uya uri…? [Congregation says, “urimo,”] urimo. Vamwe voenda vonotanga Presbyterian, but mweya uya uri…? [Congregation says, “urimo,”] urimo. Vamwe vonotanga Hwisiri but mweya uya urimo.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka mweya uyu, kereke iyi inonzi, mweya wayo wadhakwisa nyika dzo…? [Congregation says, “dzose.”] Handi’moona? Saka, I want you to understand, ndoyatinoti Message iyoyi manje. Patinoti isusu tiri Mwenga. Patinoti takasiyana nema deno…? [Congregation says, “ma denomination.”] Ndopatinosiyana pacho ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndomutsauko wacho pau…? [Congregation says, “pauri,”] pauri. Vazhinji vanoti vakapinda mu Message voti, “Inini difference handiyidii…? [Congregation says, ‘handiyione,’] handi’ione. Ha—ha—handinzwisise kuti chamunoti imimi eh…Message chii. Nokuti ukangoenda kuSavadha vanotendawo [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] the same. Ukaendawo ku Salvation Army… [Apostle Gumbura claps once—ED] Kungonamata. Mwari ndiye mumwe chete.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: No! Ndosaka Muri kuona iye zvino tinoemphasiaiza kuti, Mwari weBarika! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isu hatinamate Mwari asingadi barika. Ehe, Mwari asingadi barika iwe haumunamate iwewe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Iwe unonamata Mwari wechii…? [Congregation says, “webarika.”] Ehe. Tonamata Mwari webarika. Ukapinda mune church inoti Mwari wedu watinonamata haadi barika, isu hatimunamatewo iye Mwari iyeye. Ndewani iyeye? [Congregation says, “ndewavo,”] ndewavo. Isu tonamata Mwari webarika.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka kana kuvana vangu vakabva kuchikoro, ndoti, “Hevoi vana vebarika.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. “Munotenda here Mwari weba…? [Congregation says, ‘webarika,’] nekuti dai Mwari webarika Iyeye asipo imi mungade musi…?” [Congregation says, “musipo.”] Zvonzi, “Ehe.” Ndoti, “Kombo, unotenda here Mwari webarika?” Zvonzi, “Ehe.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “Tito, unotenda here Mwari webarika?” Ndoti, “Ehe.” “Kimberly, unotenda here Mwari webarika?” “Ehe.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ini ndi—ndikaona vana vangu vachibuda mumota kudai vakazara so, ndinotenda, kwete mwari we monogamy, ah-ah! Ndotenda Mwari weyi…? [Congregation says, “webarika.”] Ndotenda Mwari webarika, handi’moona ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] NdoMwari wandinodii inini…? [Congregation says, “wandinotenda,”] wandinonamata. Ndikaona madzimai angu aka—akazara kudaiwo, achiuya kwandiri kana vangava vatatu, vachinditi, “Mamukasei baba,” handitende mwari we—wechiRoma. Handitende mwari wechi Methodist, nokuti iyeye mwari iyeye, zvevakadzi vakawanda anozviti hupo…? [Congregation says, “hupombwe.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ko iwewe unowirirana naye papi? Saka according to that god, you are an adulterer. According to that god, vana vako iwewe ma ba…? [Congregation says, “ma bastards.”] Saka muri kunamata Mwari wakafanana papi pacho? Hee? Handi’moona mu’kunamata Mwari akasiyana? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Isusu wedu watinonamata isusu, anoona vakadzi vangu as wives. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Owona vana vangu sevana chai…? [Congregation says, “chaivo.”] Ndiye Mwari webarika wandinonamata.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Handinyare kuti nditaure kana ndikasangana nevamwe vanhu vanotenda ma Spoken Word kuti, “Imimi Mwari wenyu wamunonamata handiye wandodii…?” [Congregation says, “wandonamata.”] “Ah-ah! Iwe unonamata mwari we monogamy, ini ndonamata Mwari webarika. We are two different pe…? [Congregation says, ‘people.’] Ha’moona. Hapana na—hapana chatakafanana ipa…? [Congregation says, ‘ipapo,’] ipapo, ehe.” And we will never agree on the… Kuti unditi vana vangu vese varipo, kana kuti— Eh, vana vaMai Shiphra i six. Ini ndine twenty-two children. So, remove the six, all those are illegitimate? All those are sins? All those are bastards? Saka ini ndichiti ndinonamata Mwari weBarika! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: And I don’t mind in a brother being specific, kuti Mwari uyu webarika wacho uyu kauyu, ndiye Mwari wa Bro—wa Apostle Gu…? [Congregation says, “Gumbura,”] Gumbura. Ah, ko handi’ muBhaibhiri mainzi, “Mwari waAbra…? [Congregation says, ‘Abraham,’] Isaka nani…?” [Congregation says, “naJakobho.”] Zvainzarwo here muBhaibhiri? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kuti, “Mwari waAbrahama, Isaka nani…?” [Congregation says, “naJakobho.”] Ehe. Ende Mwari waAbrahama ndiye umwe chete here webarika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Abrahama aive nebarikaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari wa Moses ndiye umwe cheteka webarika futi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen, ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Handi’muri kupaonaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwari waJakobo ndiye here webarika futi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Jakobo aive nevangani? [Congregation says, “four,”] four. Iyeye, iyeye, I want to be specific to everyone in the New Testament. I want kuti ku Cerebration Centre vazive kuti inini handinamate uyu, wavari kunamata iye zvi…? [Congregation says, “iye zvino.”] Ini ndonamata uyu waJakobo uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvonzi, “Unonamatirei iyeyi?” Ndoti, “Ndiye weba…?” [Congregation says, “webarika.”] [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hallelujah. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Tonamata Mwari weba…? [Congregation says, “webarika,”] webarika. Anenge ari we monogamy isu hatimunamate.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Worse still, anozodzidzisa vanasikana kuzara ma nun aya. Vari kuma monastery vana ava vasingaro…? [Congregation says, “vasingaroorwi.”] Varume dzichinzi dziite tsvimbo…? [Congregation says, “tsvimborume.”] Iyeye Mwari handidi kumuona iyeye, panyika pano handidi kumuona. Dai ndaimuona achifamba ndaimupfura! Nokuti haazi chii…? [Congregation says, “haazi Mwari.”] Haazi Mwari, anorambidza vanhu kuti vawa…? [Congregation says, “vawande.”] Hm? Mwari anotsotsa dhara handitika? Kusvika rinochembera dhara richiti ndi bishop? Hee? Rozotanga kupomba raku…? [Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Haaa izvozvo izvo. [Apostle chuckles—ED] Izvozvo izvo ngatirambei vanhu vaMwari handiti, ehe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handi’makazozviona mese pa—pa—pa—pa—pa—paterevhizheni apa? Munhu hupenyu hwake hwese kupikira achiti ndibishopi, handiti? A’amudhara mukuru-kuru, handiti, kwakutanga kuchidii manje? Kuchitsvaga vakadzi. Ko anga aripi all along? Ende vese vakadzi ava vaari kutora; kupomba che…? [Congregation says, “chete.”] Hapana mbereko inobva—inobuda ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Haa?

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ende ndomaitiro echikara ichi. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chikara ichi chapanisha vanhu vakadii…? [Congregation says, “vakawanda.”] Brother… Ndhlalambi vane mukoma wavo anotori—mu—atova bishopi as we are talking right now. But ane mwana wa’akaita ari fata. Pavakanga va’akuda kunobhadhara damage yemwana uyu, akaenda achiti mwana ndewangu ndiani… Brother Ndhlalambi. Handi’muchaziva ndichikutaurirai kudhara? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mwana wacho va’akutogara naye, ariko kumba kwavo uko. Handi’moona? But avava, ava kuchechi kwavanopinda hazvidii…? [Congregation says, “hazviziikamwe.”] Hee.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndopandakabata kuti ava vanhu ava ka, havazi vanhu vekuteedzera. Ndiye woga here iyeye? [Congregation says, “ah-ah.”] Ma sister mazhinji amunoona uku ane majaya nemhandara vari mutaundi umu. But you will never…? [Congregation says, “know.”] Hm? Anongozvara onosiira mbuya vake. “Mbuya chisarai nemwana uyu. Ini munoziva ndakapikira. [Congregation laughs—ED] Zvataita izvi hazvidii…? [Congregation says, ‘hazviite.’] Ehe, ndakupai si—mbu—mbuya. Ini ndaakudzokera ku—ku—ku nunnery.” Odzokera. Handiti? Fata vakaita mwana vanongouyawo naye kurudzi rwekavo. “Mukoma, iwe ndiwe uri kunze ini ndiri fata ini, ndapara mhosva iyi. Mwana uyu.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ha’moona zvavanoita vanhu vaya? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’munoona? But isusu manje mwari we type iyoyo hatimudii…? [Congregation says, “hatimude.”] Toda Mwari wemashuwa. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka ma brothers ese, vari kuhedhuka on the basis yekuti nyaya iri kuvanetsa ndeyebarika; I have no sympathy over a man like that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] He should know better, [Congregation says, “Amen,”] iye pacha…? [Congregation says, “pachake.”] Ehe. He should know better kuti haisi nyaya, ha’moona.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: And women, ha’moona, ukaona murume anouya kuzokutaurira kuti iwewe barika rakashata, museke. Handi’moona, unomuti, “Hezvo. Ko zvauri nyope.” Wonzi, “Ndaita nyope…” Woti, “Haudi kusevenza uchishandira vana. Haa. Woda kuti ubve panyika pano waita tuvana tutatu, kana tushanu. Benzi romunhu.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ende munhu wese, munhu wese asingadi kubereka vana, munhu wese asingadi kubereka vana, it’s in complete defiance of a commandment from Go…? [Congregation says, “from God.”] Mwari akati, “Multi…? [Congregation says, ‘multiply,’] be ye fru…? [Congregation says, ‘fruitful,’] and multiply and re…?” [Congregation says, “replenish the earth.”] Akataura mashoko iwayo ndiani? [Congregation says, “ndiMwari.”] Ndiani akati, “Berekanai mudii…?” [Congregation says, “muwande.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka ndiani akazouya akati musabereke? Ndi Satan. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka munhu wese anoda kukudzidzisa kuti usabereke, iti, “Ko ruGwaro rwunorevei? Mwari achisika Adam naIvha, [Eve—ED] wakavapa commandement iri pachena chena yatiri kuverenga te… ? [Congregation says, ‘tese,’] tese. Iwe wa’akuuya nhasi waakuti tiregere kuberekana, but iri Bhaibhiri riri kutaura kuti, ‘Berekanai muwande.’ Iri.” Mwari achisika munhu achimuisa mu Eden, hanzi, “Berekanai muwande.” Iwe wa’akunzi usaroorwe, uyu a’akunzi usaroore. Motora ma sisters, millions and millions, movazarira mu nunnery. Hm?

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndopamunoona kuti zvaidanira Mweya wemuporofita. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ende uchitaura to a special class of peo…? [Congregation says, “of people.”] Murume anoticha zvinhu izvi, anofanira kuva munhu anenge aine ka prophetic insight. Anokwanisa kujoinidza maGwaro, iro nero…? [Congregation says, “neroro,”] nerororo. And that kind of man, takaziva kuti inyeredzi yechinomwe. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndo’vatakaoana muchizvarwa chatiri kudii ichi…? [Congregation says, “chatiri kurarama.”] Ehe, nyeredzi yechinomwe yakauya muchinguva—munguva yedu inoyi. Nyeredzi yechinomwe. Yauya nyeredzi yechinomwe iyaya manje, William Marrion Bra…? [Congregation says, “Branham.”] Ndiye ngwe-e, paChaedza chiya chiya ichi. Chikara ndobva chawira pai…? [Congregation says, “pasi,”] ha’moona. Handeyi tinoverenga tione kuti chikara chakaparara here? Tinyatsoona. Handei kuna Revelations 18. Heemeni. Tasvika kuna Revelations chapter 18? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 1 iyo tese, verse 1 tese: And after these things…

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Aihwa, tese hatiite Ameni tese. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei tose: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory. Heimen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] verse 2 hativerengei: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Handitika? [Congregation says, “Catholic.”] Touya panapa, that woman is decked in pur…? [Congregation says, “purple,”] purple, mukuzviona? Ndiye mudzimai mumwe chete iyeye, iKereke iyi. A woman types a chur…? A church. Mudzimai uyu, ha’moona. Ane power, ha’moona? Yaanayo. Ane beast rake raano—rimupa simba, that’s where she feeds from. Handi’moona? Handei mberi muone. Ah verse 4, And the womon was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour… (Handi’Muri kuzviona) She is rich and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication,

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Filthiness of her teaching. But ndoda kuti muone one important thing chandoda kuti mutarise apa. Muri kuona here, kuti, kukuvadzana pamweya handiti? Kukuvadzana pamweya, tichiparidzirana zvinhu zviri wrong, zvirikufananidzwa nekupomba. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kuzviona here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] The Word is referring… Do you think it’s literally fornication iri kutaurwa apa? [Congregation says, “no.”] Ndopaya ndichikutaurirai kuti munhu waMwarika, unozviuraya ukapota uchibatana nevakadzi veny…? [Congregation says, “venyika.”] I fornication iyoyo yauri kuita iyoyo. Ma sister ese anoita tsika idzo dzokukundika nevarume vemunyika, uri kuuraya vana vako vaunozvara. Uri kuuraya offspring yaani…? [Congregation says, “yako.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Don’t allow that spirit, because murume wese waunobatana naye munyika imomo, mweya waanawo hauudii…? [Congregation says, “hauwuzivi.”] I wish you could see that. Iyi fornication iri kurehwa, it’s fornication inongonzi fornication, fornication. Ndopanosimuka brother kuenda kunotora musikana wemunyika wausingazive kuti murudzii. Vamwe vanhu vanodya eh m—m rwaivhi. Vamwe vanhu vanodya matatya. Vamwe vanhu vanodya kamba. Vamwe vanhu vano… Ti—vanhu vakasiyana and tichikura kudayi, tine nyora dzatinotemherwa. Maporiji atinodii… atinodya.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinozongova a royal priesthood nekugeseswa neRopa reGwayana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] We are a royal prie…? [Congregation says, “priesthood,”] nekugeseswa neRopa rei…? [Congregation says, “reGwayana.”] Chiimajena a royal priesthood yonoita commit fornication with a witch doctor. Hee? Imagine a sister agezeswa neRopa reGwayana nemvura dzeSho…? [Congregation says, “dzeShoko.”] Anenge aine murume ane pfuma yake yechikwambo.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Simba rake nderekuti mukadzi wese wa’apfi—wa—wa’arara naye handitika? Chikwambo checho chobva chaita take over. Chichirarama nemukadzi iyeye, chikwambo chiya. Chichirarama neropa nguva nenguva yaanotera mukadzi uyu handiti, hee? Munyika mune mushonga umu. Mune mudzimai mumwe aigara achichema. Aigara achichema, aive na sister vatainamata navo panapa akaconfai-dha [confided—ED] kwavari awona vachinamata.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Zvikanzi, “Inini murume wangu, inini, ndirikutambura kuti ndomutiza sei?” Zvikanzi, “Anoita sei?” Sister vakati, “Nhayi ndonomudza kuti kudii?” Ndikati, “Ah! Ah! Ah! Siyana naye. Haumbofa wakamudii iwe? Haufa wakamugona mukadzi iyeye, musiyei.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Murume wake aiita mari. Aitouya kuchikoro nemotokari inotyisa, ku college kwavakanga vari. But every time manheru, murume uyu aidya sadza handitika? Achiseva mudzimai uyu. Muri kuzviona zvaanenge achiita? Hee? Ropa rekumai…? Reku—rekuma periods aya, rekuteera. Anenge achitora sadza rake kudai oseva pamukadzi. Uyu mudzimai anenge akarara kudai, uyu achiseva achidya sadza.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndiudze kuti zvinoita izvozvo? Kunyangwe une Benz panze apo, makambozviona kwasni? Ndikati sister, iyeye siyanai nani…? Naye hanzvadzi. Hatigoni kumubatsira kana isu pano. Handi’vatova nevana vavo four, five. Anozozvigona kuramba murume iyeye? Iyo mota iya agoisiya? Ah! Ingomuudzai kuti, “Iwe kana uchigona kuita stand yako, ita stand yako. Urambe, utendeuke.” But type yakadaro ikangoregera inodii? Inofa.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: As if that wasn’t enough uyu anga ari kuChinhoyi uyu. Ndobva vamwe sister vanga vari kunoku, paSeka apa. Ndobva vasangana ne friend yavo futi… Zvizere zvinhu zvandiri kungokutaurirai izvi, ehe. Wepa Seke apa manje friend yacho mudzim—murume wacho handitika? Murume uyu wakanga asingarare husiku hwese. Kusvika mukadzi uyu ayiuya, kuchikoro achirara padhesiki kudai achichema. This man would not sleep. Ayive neka hari kake. Kekuti aingoti akangotarisa akurara manheru, anotora miiri yake o—opinza muhari muya uyu. Apedza kupinza muiri yake muhari owuya kumhuri kusvika ngwee… Handi’huroyi? Handi’huroyi masikati machena handiti? Ndovati… But panze apa muchinda bhima ana…? [Congregation says, “anayo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Varimu double chii? [Congregation says, “storey.”] Mukasvikapo imi munongobatikana vanhu vanotarisa zvenya…? Zvenyama. Ndopandakabata kutika fornication ine marudzi akasiyana siyana. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hee? Don’t do that my brother! Ha’moona? Ndosaka imi ma sister haikona kuti ukaona mupfanha amisa ka two door kake, wobatikana naye. Unomuziva? Unoziva kuri kubva mari yake? Hee? Wobatikana naye. Kune vamwe vanhu vanogeza nemishonga inoita kuti vai—vakwidzime pamberi pevanhu, vayemurike, vakwezve. Ha’moona? Tererai muone quotation iyi, it will—you will enjoy it tererai muone. Righchi: You see it now behooves us to discover the ogi—original mother and child.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: They have gone a step further ka? Vakunamata mai. Hanzi, “Ngatinyararei Mwari uyu… Mwari uyu anenge asingataure uyu. Handei kune wedu uyu. Now… It now behooves us to discover the original mother and child. The original goddess-mother of Babylon was Semiramis who was called Rhea in the eastern countries. In her arms she held a son, who though a babe, was described as a tall, strong, handsome and—man and especially captivating to the women.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuona manamati… Varume vamwe vamunoti mukaona akarova dark shades ake kudai, achibuda mumotokari kudai unorohwa nehana kumira wega kudai. Woshaya kuti ko chinombori chii? Ha’moona? Hamusati mamboona varume vakadaro, vekuti you can’t help it, handitika? Anongoti achingobuda mumota kuti… rinongoti… Iro rinenge richizviziva kuti effect iyoyo pavarume—pavakadzi rina…? [Congregation says, “rinayo.”] Unowoona richiita kubuda so, robuda so woona rodaiwo [0:43:28.2-inaudible] …Woona rotora magirazi aro soo. [Apostle makes a demonstration of the kind of these worldly men and Congregation laughs—ED] Unoona mukadzi wako unaye pa side kutura mafemo. Mukadzi wako iwewe anotura mafemo. [Apostle and Congregation laughs—ED]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Mukadzi wako anotora mafemo iwe woshaya kuti, ah! Hee? “Ko watura mafemo neyi nhaiwe? Hee?” Iwe …?... “Ndazviona zvaitika, ehe.” Awona Tammuz. Ndi Tammuz waasangana nani…? [Congregation says, “naye,”] naye. Vana Tammuz vakadii…? [Congregation says, “vakawanda.”] Aah! ini ndakavaona mu—ende machinda acho akawanda. Patakaita care—car accident ye—ye ne—naM ai Zani ava. Takaita car accident ne double cab apa Mai Zani apa. Paka—pakauya vapfanha two, vanga vaine ka two door kavo. Ndobva vanomisa pamberi apo vari vaviriso, machinda marefuso. Ndobva vadzoka achifamba kudaiwo. [Apostle demonstrates the way these man walked—ED] Haa? Ini nda’andine ma sisters andandinawo.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndakavaona ma sister ese kupera basa, kupera basa. Vakavatarisa so. [Congregation laughs—ED] Vatoziva ma sister iwayo …?... [Congregation laughs–ED] Vakapera basa ma—machinda achiuya. Achi… Ende vanenge vari soft spoken vachita so, dzinofamba senyo… senyoka, gentle. [ Apostle demonstrates the way these men walked and Congregation laughs—ED] “Ko muri right here mudhara? Ko chii chaitika panapa? Oh, very sorry, very sorry. l see. Okay.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Unongoona ma sister ako achisara akangodaio …?... [Sisters laugh—ED] Mweya yesvina iyo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Mweya iyoyo iriko chai…? [Congregation says, “chaizvo.”] Handi’moona. Ndosaka Bhaibhiri rinobva rataura kuti they are there. Ndosaka imimi ma sisters it’s important, kuti kana munhu usinganamate naye, usadanane nani…? [Congregation says, “naye.”] Tora mus—brother vamanamata navo, vawa’akuziva chapupu chaani…? [Congregation says, “chavo.”] Chapupu chavo wa’akuvaziva. Ndosaka vamwe vedu, munoona kuti unotadza kubuda mumweya we victim. Unoramba uri mumweya we defeat. Unoramba uchiti ukarwara…

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Isu toti tikarwara topora mangwana. Saizvozvizvi nezuro nda’ndakabaiwa ne flue zvisingadii…? [Congregation says, “zvisingaiti.”] Ndichingoita, “Haa…” Iyo inongoyerera madziwa iyi, flu iyi. Ndobva ndarara ndikati, “Ah, rega ndizorore.” Masikati chaiwo ndatomborara. Masikati kutomboti roro nehope ku—for three hours. But can you believe I was sick in the morning? Mwari vanokunzwa ipa…? [Congregation says, “ipapo.”] Anokunzwa ipapo, ha’moona.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Unongoti, “Mwari ndibatsirei, Mwari ndiitirei nyasha.” Watoona gwindiri, gwindiri, gwindiri, gwindiri, gwindiri, zvatodii…? [Congregation says, “zvatopera.”] Vamwe brother munoisa maoko maisazve. Mugodira bhodhoro reoiri rese kudii…? [Congregation laughs—ED] Bhodhoro reoiri rese kupera munotenga manyowane, handitika ehe. Hanzvadzi kana hama haidii…? [Congregation says, “haipore.”] Haa? Ndopandakabata kuti aah, ah-ah! “Kune vakamugamuchira wakavapa simba.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka ipo pano patiri ipo panapa. Tatova mumweya wekuti tigugudze [Apostle knocks several times on the pulpit—ED] tizarurirwe window rede…? [Congregation says, “redenga.”] Tinofanira kuva nemari yedu isiri yemusho…? [Congregation says, “yemushonga.”] Mari yeropafadzo rinobva kunani…? [Congregation says, “kuna Mwari.”] Tofanira kuva nezvimiro zvino contrasta zvaSa…? [Congregation says, “zvaSatani,”] zva Satani. Ndosaka tichiti ngatichinjei status ye…? [Congregation says, “yedu.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Mm? Vaya vanenge vaine mushonga vakageza. Vanenge vachigeza pamwe nemvura dzenyoka, vamwe vachigeza nechii, you never know. Zviya zvainzi, Michael Jackson anogeza nemvura yeku uterus. Ha’moziva zvaingotaurwa ma story, hee? Ndoyaanoti kana aka—ma—ma—madzimai anenge akubatsirwa aya. Pa—paunenge wa’akuno deliver, handi’kunotanga kwabuda mvura? Mvura iyoyo ndoyaanochingidzira. Ndoyaaigeza nayo kume… kumeso. Hamuna kumbozvinzwa izvozvo? Haa? Saka mishonga munyika umu iri…? [Congregation says, “irimo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: But chimirai ndichikutaurirai manje, yese mishonga iyoyo put together, hapana chinokunda Mweya Mutsvene. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Kutsotswa kwevanhu naSa…? [Congregation says, “naSatani.”] Mwari vakada havo kukuumba kuti uite chimiro ipapapo, vanhu vanoshaya kuti chii. Vanongoona kuti this man is a bit di…? [Congregation says, “different.”] Pane chizoro chiri payi…? [Congregation says, “paari.”] Ndo the same nevasikana, haikonai kubatikana nevanhu vakadaro ivavavo. Vanhu vanoseenzeswa naSatani.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukatarisa brother, varume kana vanoimba ma Rock and Roll ukavaona. Aaah, vana Elvis Presley. Haa? Kuti muone kuti hauzi mushonga waunenge wapuhwa nambuya vako, kana nasekuru vako eh kuChiweshe uko, kana kwaChurumhanzu. Elvis Presley wakasvika kuChiweshe? But vakanga vasingacheme vakadzi, haa? Achi—achiimba aka—achi— [Apostle imitates Elvis Presley’s singing—ED] Vakadzi vaiita kumhanya kuenda kunobata. Achiva—ndiye aka introducer manje, matrauzi anodii…? [Congregation says, “anobata.”] Anga anzwa nekubvarurirwa chii…? [Congregation laughs—ED] Anga anzwa nekubvarurirwa ma trousers nevai… nevakadzi.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndobva anzi chiita skin ti… ? [Congregation says, “tight.”] Kuti ukabata inongodii… inongosvedza. [Apostle imitates Elvis Presley’s singing and Congregation laughs—ED] Ende rinenge riri rume. Handi’moona? Mukaona ndozvavari kwe…? [Congregation says, “kwese.”] Iwe ukavaona iti, “Tammuz, ndamuona Tammuz paagere uyu,” ha’moona? Brother Branham vanovapa zita, tererai muone. Hanzi, “You, see?” He says here, hanzi: In her arms she held a son, who though a babe, was described as tall, strong, handsome and especially captivating to the women. Right… In Ezekiel 8:14 that man is called Tammuz.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuzviona? Anonzi ani? [Congregation says, “Tammuz.”] [Apostle chuckles—ED] Ha’moona? Vana Tammuz vakadii…? [Congregation says, “vakawanda,”] vakawanda vana Tammuz. Saka haikona ku admire vana Tammuz, siyana navo: Amongst classical writers he was called Bacchus. Hanzi he was called what? [Congregation says, “Bacchus.”] To the Babylonians he was Ninus. Muri kuona anga ari mazita? What accounts for the fact that he was represented as a babe in the arms and yet described as a great and mighty man is that he is known as the “Husband-Son.” One of his titles was “Husband of the Mother”, and in India where the two are known as Iswara and Isi, (the husband) is represented as the babe at the breast of his own wife.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Mu’ona kuti chinamato chekuRoma? [Congregation says, “mm.”] Hm? Ku India chiriko. Ku Japan chiriko. Kumwe kwese chiriko. Handi’moona? Chikara ichi, chine influence isingaiti! Handi’moona? Ndosaka mukasvika nhasi uno, “Maria Musande amai vaani…?” [Congregation says, “vaMwari.”] Muri kuzvionaka? Maiona Husband-Son iyo. “Maria Musande amai vaani…? [Congregation says, ‘vaMwari,’] mutirevererewo. Amen.” Woenda ku India, anenge achinzi Iswara and Isi. Woenda ku China, handitika? Ndi Madonna and so…? [Congregation says, “son.”] Muri kuzviona? Hah? “Come out,” it’s very important vanhu vaMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndoda kuti—why am I saying all these things? Ndoda kuyedza kukubatsirai kutika, there is no correct marriage that can come from people like that. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hapana marriage iri proper inobva kuvanhu vakafanana nai…? [Congregation says, “naivavo.”] Marriage yavo yavakadzidzisa iri wro….? [Congregation says, “iri wrong.”] Ende yanga ine chinangwa chekuparadza marudzi o…? [Congregation says, “ose.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona ku history yedu ye monogamy taibata muchiona zviya zviya. Ndovanhu vaka introducer mono…? [Congregation says, “monogamy,”] because madzimai acho aive powerful iwaya, type iyoyi yemadzimai aya. Ha’moona? Ha’moona? Aive powerful mata—madzimai iwaya. Saka iwe unotofanira kuto—utongwara. Paunenge uchinamata kuti, “Mwari, I’m incapable of receiving revelation, but ndiri kukumbira manheru anhasi, ndipeiwo chizaruro.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Right, how did now this… Right, ndoda kuti muchiona. Ndakutaurirai ndoda kuemphasizer mapindiro akaita chinamato ichi kuKereke yaani…? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] How did this now get in the Chur…? [Congregation says, “in the Church,”] in the Church? Handi’mukuona? This woman... Handei kuna Revelation 17 tione. Hanzi: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet … (Handitika?) colour, and decked … (Handiti?) and decked with gold…

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Right, verse 5. Hativerengei verse 5 tese: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH. Muri kupaona apo? Verse 6, hativerengei tose: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Mukuona bhuku iri para—ra—rakutsanangura manje. Akadhakwa neropa revatsve…? [Congregation says, “revatsvene.”] Kunwa, kuuraya, vatsvene vaIshe Jeso Kristu. But John ari kuadmitter kuti but ndamutarisa kudai mukadzi uyu, ndakabatikana nezvaa…? [Congregation says, “nezvaanga ari.”] Kwete kubatikana kuti physical kana kuti kuri lustful, admiration ye spirituality yaakanga aina…? [Congregation says, “ainayo.”] Akatofunga kuti kunamata. Muri kuona Mwenga zvawaita apa manje? John anotyper Mwenga. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tinodzokera kune Zvakazarurwa chapter 1. Tarirai muone kuna Zvaka—Zvakazarurwa chapter 1. Ndoda kuti mugare muchibata zvinhu izvi. Handei kuna Zvakazarurwa chapter 1. Ndomaitiro atinenge tichiita kuti ma Me—I have taught Seven Church Ages so many times zvekuti I am now discouraged. Handichanakidzwa neku teacher kuti Ephesus. Ha-uh. Ndoenda ndichinonhonga ma truths ndoapesuwa. [to pursue—ED] Handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe. Horaiti, mukatarisa manje apa, tarirai muone panapa. Right verse 1, hativerengei verse 1 tese: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto His servants things which must shortly come to pass; and He sent and signified it by His angel unto His servant John:

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuzvionaka? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right, verse 2 hativerengei, tese: Who bare record of the Word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Mukuona ndiJohn a—Muri kuona zvatiri kuverenga zviye zvekuna Babylon zviye zviye, ndiJohn arikuo…? [Congregation says, “arikuona.”] Ndosaka ati, “I wondered in admira…?” [Congregation says, “admiration.”] Ainakidzwa nani…? [Congregation says, “nazvo.”] He bare record of everything that he…? [Congregation says, “he saw.”] Muri kuona? Handei pa verse 3 tione. Verse 3, hativerengei muone. Verse 3 tese: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kupaonaka? “Vakaropafadzwa vachaverenga, vagonzwa izvi, zvandiri kuona izvi. Zvandiri kuona izvozvo. Vachangozvinzwa kana kuzviverenga vakadii ivavo…?” [Congregation says, “vakaropafadzwa.”] “Vachangonzwa kana kuzvinzwa chete, chete, chete kana kuzviona,” so blessed are you tonight. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Nekuti zvinhu izvi uri kuzvidii…? [Congregation says, “uri kunzvinzwa,”] uri kuzvinzwa. Ha’moona? But iye John uyu, Mwenga uyu, ha’moona, tererai pa verse 9 muone. Handei pa verse 9 muone. Hativerengei pa verse 9 tichiona. Verse 9 tese: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was on the isle that is called Patmos, for the Word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Vakanga vaedza kumuuraya vakamuta…? [Congregation says, “vakamutadza.”] Vakamu boiler muma drum eoyiri. [oil—ED] Vakamudii…? [Congregation says, “vakamutadza.”] Vakamuti a witch, ndokumutushura maziso, ndokunomukanda pa Patmos. Ari pa Patmos ipapo, anga asingaoni nemaziso enya…? [Congregation says, “enyama.”] Akanga akuona neMweya and haana kunyora nepenzura kana ne ball point kana ne ink. Bhuku reZvakazarurwa rakanyorwa neropa raani…? [Congregation says, “rake.”] Ainyora ega neropa rake murume uyu. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Saka Bhuku rauri kuverenga iroro kuti risvike kwatiri, it was written in what…? [Congregation says, “blood,”] blood. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Imagine the amount of blood that went on that. Kuwanda kwazvakaita zvinhu izvi. Achi—aitora ropa rake iye achinyora because he had nowhere. Achinyora pama parchments, achinyora zvimwe pamatombo, achinyora. Ndozvakagadzirwa izvi. Zvikanzi but “Vachaona zvinhu izvi, vakaropafadzwa.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka inini kainini, kutaura chokwadi, ukaona uchikwanisa kubata zvinhu izvi kaizvi, you indeed a special class of people. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Simba raunaro pahuroyi, simba raunaro pazvinhu zvemudzimu, simba raunaro pazvivi, simba raunaro pamararamiro ako; it’s uncompared with anything. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndosaka vese vari muimba yaMwari manheru anhasi, vana vese vari muno, iti, “Mwari, ndoda capacity yekubata chizaruro.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Now, John uyu ari papi manje apa? Ndopaya paakaratidzwa seven golden ca…? [Congregation says, “candlesticks.”] Aratidzwa ma seven golden candlesticks, wainyorera mutumwa mumwe nemu…? [Congregation says, “nemumwe,”] nemumwe. Vekutanga vaakanyorera ma Ephesians. Handi’muri kuvaona ipapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, hativerengei muone kunoku, chapter 2. Chapter 2 verse 1, muone. Tasvika pa chapter 2 verse 1? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hativerengei verse 1 tese: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith He that holdeth the seven stars in His right Hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuzviona? Right verse 2 tese, hativerengei: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars: Verse 3: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for My name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Now I want you to catch verse 4. Ndoda Amen kumunhu wese pa verse 4. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chionai verse 4 now, that’s what I want you to—to emphasize on. Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Toda Amen ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo hama! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ephesus Church iyi yakanga iri—yatangwa naPauro. Yakatangwa nani Church iyi…? [Congregation says, “naPauro.”] But yadonha parudo rwayo rwekudii…? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Amen akadarika ipapo hama. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Yadonha parudo rwayo rwokudii…? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] Yadonha panamatiro avaive navo vachita….? [Congregation says, “vachitanga.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Vadonha pa commitment yavakanga vaina…? [Congregation says, “vainayo.”] Vadonha pa zeal yavakanga vaina…? [Congregation says, “vainayo.”] Tarirai next verse yacho muone, ndozvairi ku emphasizer. Hativerengei verse 5 tese, tese. Verse 5 tese: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndoda Amen akadarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Kurumidzai mudzokere kurudo rwamakanga munarwo rwokunama…?” [Congregation says, “rwokunamata.”] Uchimuka kuseni uchipa muteuro, “…fervent in prayer.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ukawira muchivi, mhanya ku burden bearer unogadzi…? [Congregation says, “unogadzira.”] Huya manheru uise mute…? [Congregation says, “muteuro,”] muteuro. Zvipirei, hanya yamaive nayo kubvira pakudii…? [Congregation says, “pakutanga,”] nekuti madonha. Madonha parudo rwamakanga muinarwo pakudii…? [Congregation says, “pakutanga.”] Makanganisika pachizaruro chamakanga munacho pakudii…? [Congregation says, “pakutanga.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mukaona ma brother ese panozopinda Satan muhupenyu hwako, kana paunotanga kunetseka nechivanhu. Kuti, “Hee hamuna kurova guva ranhingi. Hee, kune mombe dzehumai dzakarasika pakati, pakati, pakati. Ndodziri kuunza pamhepo aya. Ndodzaita kuti mwana uyu apenge. Ndo—” Ukaona zva’akudaro manje, nyaya yauya kuhupenyu hwako, “…wadonha parudo rwako rwokuta…?” [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] Tingaita Amen here ipapo hama? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Now, pakadonha Kereke iyi parudo rwayo rwokudii…? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga,”] ndopakapinda Satani. Ndosaka iwe unogona kuuya wonamata kudai, woramba vakomana vako vese vemunyika. But paunodonha parudo rwako rwokutanga, wa’akutanga kunyengwa nevakomana vemunyi…? [Congregation says, “vemunyika.”] Bhaibhiri rinoti, “Repent! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ukurumidze kudzokera kumabasa ako ekutanga.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen! [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Brother pavanouya mu Message vanoramba vasikana vavo vese vomunyika. But anamata namata one year, akunomitisa munyika after ten years mu Church. Adonha parudo rwake rwokudii…? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] Akurovha ma ser…? [Congregation says, “ma service.”] A’aku avoider, akutiza, akufamba asina kutaura. Ha’moona? A’akunyeya vafundisi, aku rebeller, ava a murmurer. Zeal iya yaakanga ayinayo pakutanga yadii…? [Congregation says, “yapera.”] He’s complaining every time, twenty-four hour complain.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “Haa ini handichafara paChechi. Haa paChechi hapana Mweya waMwari. Haa ndakanzwa kuti Brother Gumbura vakaita zvakati. Hee ndakanzwa kuti futi vakadai, vakadai. Ende doctrine yavo ye Marriage and Divorce iya iya, it’s based from weakness. Wakazo...”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ongoona kuti munhu uyu ari kungotsvaga zvinhu—hakuna akambokupinza basa iroro. When you came to Church that wasn’t your job. Pawakauya kuChechi, wakauya kuzonamata Mwari! [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Amen. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Unenge wa’a mweya wetsvina wapinda mumufanha nekuti adonha parudo rwake rwokuta...? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] But nguva yaakanga aine rudo rwekunamata Mwari, aitungamirika. Aiti akaparidzirwa kudai, odzoreka.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: He would die dai...? [Congregation says, “daily.”] And confess his sins one to a...? [Congregation says, “to another.”] But all of a sudden desire yekuconfessa chivi, haachina. Ati, “Ndakura pakunamata. Ndichiri mudiki ndaitendeuka ezvino ndakura pakunamata handichatendeuka.” Mukuona zvinoita vanhu? ‘‘Iye zvino handichareurura.’’ ‘‘Handichaconfessa manje ndava munhu mukuru pamweya. Ndakura pamweya handichatendeuka.’’

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: A’akunyepa! A’akuita zvivi. Hana yake haichadii...? [Congregation says, “haicharove.”] Conscience yake yava sea...? [Congregation says, “seared.”] Zvip—zvipime manheru anhasi muranda waMwari. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Are you not in that category of Ephesians? Haumo here mu category iyoyo? Hauchaverenga Bhaibheri rako. Hauchapupura, hauchada kana kutsanya. Hauchada kana kurara wanamata. Haa? MuChechi, worship chaiyo hauchayiinjoya. [unable to enjoy—ED] Asi kuChechi uri kudii...? [Congregation says, “uri kuuya.”] You are just a religious person. “A form of what...? [Congregation says, ‘godliness,’] But denying the power...?” [Congregation says, “thereof.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Iti, “Baba ndiitirei nyasha manheru anhasi. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda nyasha dzinobva kwamuri manheru anhasi.” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Why do we want to repent back quickly? Kana watopedza mwedzi usina kugadzira iriyo condition yauri watononokesa too...? [Congregation says, “too much.”] It was at that time, when the Church was in that condition, that Satan planted an evil seed. Ndopakapinda mweya watiri kuverenga wana Tammuz uyu. MuKereke yaani...? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Hatitarisei muone ipapo. Let me show you. Ndoda page seventy-one. Muone. Is this what I want? Right, this is not what I wanted [1:03:07.2-inaudible] I don’t know why I wrote a wrong page here. But handiyo yanda’ndichida iyoyo.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Nevertheless, we’ll see as we are going on with this Revelation [1:03:15.1-inaudible] Handitika? Let me read you this one. Right, inongotaura zvimwe chete but quotation yanga’achida handiyo exactly. But listen to this one, it’s the same thing: The very name, Ephesus, has a strange compound meaning, it means, “Aimed at,” (Handiti) “Aimed at,” then, “Relaxed.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ha’moona pfungwa yatinayo? It’s a...? [Congregation says, “aimed at,”] then? [Congregation says, “relaxed.”] Vanga vane kwavakaema. Vaine kwavakaema, kwavaida kusvika, vakaita rela...? [Congregation says, “relax.”] It will still serve the same purpose; it’s the same thing. Now, tererai: The high aspirations of this age that had begun with the fullness of the Spirit, “the depth of God,” whereby they were aiming at the high calling of God, began to give way to a less watchful attitude.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “They began to gi...? [Congregation says, “give way,”] to a what…?” [Congregation says, “a less watchful attitude.”] Va’akuderera manje pamanatiro avo, tererai muone: A less ardent following of Jesus Christ began to manifest itself as an omen (Ha’moona) that in the future ages the physical vehicle called the church would sink to the awesomefulness of the “depth of Satan.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Twakatanga kupinda iri laxing, relaxing. Vachinosinka to the depth of what...? Tererai muone pano. [1:04:48.9-inaudible] The church had become relaxed and was drifting. Already the age was backsliding. It had left its first love. Right. The tiny seed planted in that Ephesian Age would one day grow in the spirit of error until all foul birds of the air would roost in its branches.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “All foul birds,” Revelation chapter eigh...? “Every evil spi...? [Congregation says, ‘spirit,’] would roost in its what...?” [Congregation says, “branches.”] Tererai [1:05:21.1-inaudible] It had left itself. Haa? So—so inoffensive to human reasoning would that little plant appear to that New Eve (the New Church) that again she would be deceived by Satan. The Ephesian Age had presented to her the opportunity for God’s best, and for a while she prevailed, and worshipped like that and then relaxed, (Chitererai) and in that unguarde—unguarded moment Satan planted the seed of complete ruination.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “In that unguarded what…?” Satan ndobva adyara. Muri kuona kuti ndo age yedu yokutanga? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Pa age yedu yokutanga, Satani watodii ipapapo? Watodyara kudha...? [Congregation says, “kudhara.”] Saka chindiudzai kubva panguva ya Paul, mukazoenda manje kuBhaibheri muchaona Pouro kuna Acts chapter 20. Handei kuna chapter 20 Acts muone. [1:06:18.4-inaudible] Tongopedza naikoko. I hope to… get that one, Acts 20. Tasvika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Right, tarirai pa verse 17. Tiri kuona pa verse 17? IEphesian [It’s the Ephesian—ED] Church age ka yatiri kuverenga iyaya. Hativerengei verse 17: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Adaidza ma chur—ma elders eku Church yekupi? [Congregation says, “Ephesus.”] Handi’muri kuzvinzwaka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Aanyorera—ma officer, zvikanzi, “Imbouyai kuno,” naPauro. “Ndoda kuti ndikutaurirei.” Hationei kuti aivaudza chii Pauro vanhu ava. Hatitarisei muone verse 18: And when they were come to him, he said unto them, Ye know, from the first day that I came into Asia, after what manner I have been with you at all seasons, Serving the Lord with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuzvionaka varanda vaMwari? Handei mberi: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you, but have shewed you, and have taught you publickly, and from house to house, Handei mberi: Testifying both to the Jews, and also to the Greeks, repentance toward God, and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Verse 22: And now, behold, I go bound in the Spirit unto Jerusalem, not knowing the things that shall befall me there: Verse 23: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me. Verse 24: But none of these things move me, neither count I my life dear unto myself, so that I might finish my course with joy, and the ministry, which I have received of the Lord Jesus, to testify the Gospel of the grace of God.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Verse 25: And now, behold, I know that ye all, among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God, shall see my face no more. Tingaita Amen here ipapapo? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ari kutaura kuti nda’akunodii murume uyu? 128[Congregation says, “nda’akunofa,”] nda’akunofa. “Hamuchazoona futi huso hwangu zvaka...? [Congregation says, ‘zvakare.’] Imi vandakaparidzira Vhangeri. But ndino zvandoda kukusiyai ndakuudza...?” [Congregation says, “ndakuudzai.”] Aida kuvaudza chii, hatione? Verse 26 tese: Wherefore I take you to record this day, that I am pure from the blood of all men. For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kupabataka varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Handina kuneta kukutaurirai zvakadzika zvohushe hwaMwari! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Doctrine yose yekunamata ndakakuudzai yo...? [Congregation says, ‘yose.’] I’m innocent, I’m clean.” Ha’moona? Handei mberi tone. Verse 28 tese: Take heed therefore unto yourselves, and to all the flock, over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers, to feed the Church of God, which He hath purchased with His own Blood. Verse 29: For I know this, that after my departing shall grievous wolves enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Tingaita Amen here varanda vaMwari? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Toda Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Handisi kumunzwa Amen iyeye. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hanzi, “Kune makava achapinda mumakwa...? [Congregation says, ‘mumakwai.’] Ini nde’ndisisipo. Asi chokwadi ndakakudzidzi...? [Congregation says, ‘ndakakudzidzisai.’] Chokwadi ndakakudzidzisai. But ndoziva kuti ndichingobva panapa ma—ma—makava achapinda, achiedza kuda kunoparadza Kere...? [Congregation says, ‘Kereke.’] But imimi Shoko ndakudzidzisai.”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Chionai kuti makava ava, aibva kunze chete here? Hatitarisei muone next verse muone. Verse 30 hativerengei tose: Also of your own selves shall men arise, speaking perverse things, to draw away disciples after them.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Muri kuzviona? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] “Pakati penyu pachaitawo futi mhandu dzichadii ipapa…? [Congregation says, ‘dzichasimuka.’] Pane vanhu vari imo muno imimi ma elders andadaidza imimi. Pamaeredha ipapa pane chii ipapapa...? Pane mhandu futi pamaeredhazi apa.” Muri kuzviona kuti ma elders dzinosevenzeswa kamhandu dziya sa—naSatani? Kana Mwari vakashaikwa kungowanikwa pakati pavo. Hanzi, “Imi ma elders ipo, pakati penyu imi vandadaidza ndiri kuonekana nemi kudai. Pakati penyu pane, mhandu dzichakanganisa, dzoda kuti dziite vanhu vanovateverera. Makava achadii futi…?”

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka muna Ephesian Church Age, after Pouro afa ta’akuona kuti Kereke yadonha parufo—parudo rwayo rwokuta...? [Congregation says, “rwokutanga.”] Ma elders ayaya akanga aonekwa naPauro aizosimuka aya, akatanga kudira mvura nekuti Pouro hapasisi...? [Congregation says, “hapasisina.”] Waneiwo vaya vakanga vasina kugadzirira zvakanaka zvakatanga kuva affe...? Ma elders aya akatanga kusevenzewa naSatani u...? Ma elders aya akanhe—akaderera aya ndokunobatana nema wolves aya. “...wolves in sheep what…?” [Congregation says, “skin.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndokuuya muKereke yaMwa...? [Congregation says, “yaMwari.”] Chechi yamwa, padzidziso yemweya yesvi...? [Congregation says, “yesvina.”] Ha’moona zvakaitika pachizvarwa ichi? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Muri kuona mapindiro… Handi’takuratidzai kuti mweya uyu unobva ku Egypt? Ugobva ku Greece, ugobva ku Asia, ugobva ku Roma but muri kuona manje pa Church age yekutanga wapinda muChe...? [Congregation says, “muChechi.”] Wava...? [Congregation says, “wavamo.”] Wakudzidzisa trinity, wakudzidzisa women preaching. Wakudzidzisa monogamy. Wakudzidzisa baptism in the Name of the Father, Son and the Holy...? [Congregation says, “Holy Ghost.”] Wakudzidzisa infant ba...? [Congregation says, “baptism.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Wapinda, zviri kuenda zvichikora, zvichikora as we go alo...? [Congregation says, “along.”] Kusvika patinosvika pa Fourth Church age, chaedza chaicho chaicho chaitwa extinguished, cheShoko raMwari. Ta’akutomirira restoration yaana Luther. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ha’moona zvinoita Mwarika kunaka Kwake handitika? [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ehe, ta’akumirira, “The just shall live by...?” [Congregation says, “by faith.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nemumwe wedu ari mukati memba ino iyi, ukaona wapinda muimba yaMwari. Ngwarira zuva nezuva kuti Satani chine mashandiro achinodii...? [Congregation says, “achinoita.”] Chine mapindiro achinoita mukati meKereke. Chinouya kana nekupurupiti. Chinouya kana nekuma deacon. Chinouya kana nekumudzimai wako. Chinouya kana nekumurume wako. Chinouya kana nekuna vamwe brother, haumbozive. But the only way to defend that thing, handi’muri kupaona? Kunamata Mwari muMweya nemui...? [Congregation says, “nemuZvokwadi.”] Haikona kunetseka nezvauri kusangana nazvo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Let’s just finish with this quotation to encourage you. Ndoda kungokuenkarejaiwo [to encourage—ED] on this one handitika? Ndonakidzwa chaizvo ini neShoko iri. Right, ndoda page 82. Tererai muone: No matter how just and upright a Christian is before the public, and how gracious he is to his fellow man, doing naught but good, let him confess Christ as his Saviour and acknowledge the operation of the gifts of the Holy Spirit in tongues, prophecy, healing and miracles, and he will be condemned. The spirit of this world hates the Spirit of God, and because it can’t overcome the Spirit of the Lord it tries to destroy the vessel in whom the Spirit of Truth dwells. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chitererai: Persecution and trials are a natural, normal part of the Christian life. There is only one thing you can do about them. Commit them all to God, judge not, and leave their outworking and final judgment to Him.

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiitei Amen anodarika Amen ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Miyedzo ichagara ichidii...? [Congregation says, “ichiuya.”] Asi iwe hauna zvaunogona kuita pamusoro paani...? [Congregation says, “payo.”] Nyengetera che...? [Congregation says, “chete,”] woisiya kunaani...? [Congregation says, “kuna Mwari.”] Kutukwa unotukwa. Kusa apprecietwa [appreciated—ED] hauappreciatewe. Kusvorwa, kudii but uchiita basa raMwari. Wakamira muchitendero chai...?

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: “Haa ini handichadi kunamata kwacho ndiri kuedza kuita muKristu...” Wobva... Ah-ah Satani chatodii...? Chatopinda. “Ko zvandaedzawo kuita zvakati? Ko zvandinotsvairawo, ndogobikawo, ndogo... Ko zvandisinga appreciatewo wani? Ko zvandinowachawo?” Ha-ah! Trials and persecutions will always have. You are always misunder...? [Congregation says, “understood.”] Ukaona waremerwa tora nyaya yako, woiisa pamberi paani...? [Congregation says, “paMwari.”] But haikona kufunga zvekudzokera kumai...? [Congregation says, “kumasure.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ukangodaro chete, pa moment yaunenge wakaderera iyo iyaiya, Satani [Apostle claps once—ED] chabva chadii...? Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzekunzwa ngavanzwe! [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Zvinotaura chii...? [Congregation says, ‘Mweya.’] Mweya kupiko varanda vaMwari.” [Congregation says, “muKereke.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Iti, “Baba ndibatsirei. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndipei chizaruro ichi, chekuziva mweya waka—wakabata maChechi o...?” [Congregation says, “ose.”] Why isu tichiparidza manje kuva—muri kuti, “Come out, from amo...?!” [Congregation says, “among them.”] Tiri kukuitireyi kuti mubve? Kuvenga Salvation? Kuvenga Methodist? Kuvenga Angrican here? Ah-ah! Chizaruro chatiinacho. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Chizaruro chinoti kune Mwenga usina hwinya kana gwa…? [Congregation says, “kana gwapa.”] Ende iwewe unofanira kuva a part of that Bride. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndiwe Mwenga wacho iwewe. Haufaniri kuva nevakomana vemunyika, mishonga, kudyisa varume. Ma brother haafaniri kutora zvifeve, kuromba kana kurova vakadzi. Aiwa! Unofanira kuva shewe chai…? [Congregation says, “chaivo.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ende mhuri imwe neimwe ngaive ne one acco…? [Congregation says, “accord.”] Baba vachiriritira mhuri yavo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Vachitsvaga masimba kubva kunani…? [Congregation says, “kuna Mwari,”] kuna Mwari. Mudzimai achizvininipisa pasi pemurume wake. Achiti, “Shewe,” kumurume wake. Vakabatana vachikudza mhuri yavo pamwe…? [Congregation says, “pamwe chete.”] Hanzi, “Vane nzeve dzokunzwa, ngavazwe!” [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Hatiite Amen akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ndoda Ameni akadarika ipapo. [Congregation says, “Amen.”] Ameni iyeye handisi kumunzwa? [Congregation says, “Amen.”]

entries.title: The Revelation (Part 2)
entries.text: Ndosaka mumwe nomumwe wedu ngaati, “Mwari ndiitireyi nyasha. [Congregation says, ‘Amen.’] Ndoda kuti murambe muchindikudza, muchindinyengeredza kuswedera padyo Nemi. Ndichisimba mukati mokunamata kwangu, ndichiita committed zuva rimwe nei…? [Congregation says, ‘nerimwe.’] Ndichiita, ‘Die da…?’” [Congregation says, “daily.”] Hatiperereyi ipapo manheru anhasi. Hatisimukeyi hedu tese. Glory, glory, glory, (Oh) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me It must have been the Hand of the Lord. (Glory, glory) Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (My Lord) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me It must have been the Hand of the Lord. (Glory, glory) Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (Yeah) Somebody touched me Glory, glory, glory, (Hoo) Somebody touched me It must have been the Hand of the Lord.
